dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, prominent white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts, displaying high grayscale contrast against darker wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp boundary sharpness; pale bluish-gray edges are clearly visible along the margins of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, distinct white rectangular patch is visible centrally on the posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct and linear boundary separating the black nape from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, large white auricular (cheek) patch bordered by black plumage on the crown and throat.
